provisional: Two independent-source studies fed this: one could not open the leaderboards (it read search summaries) and one that could, which found real numbers only for older models (Qwen3, Qwen2.5-Coder, Llama 3.1) and none for most 2026 models. So summaries and facts go to Qwen3 (lowest hallucination on the Vectara leaderboard), code to the Coder model (BigCodeBench-Hard), reasoning to Qwen3.5-9B (index rank, low confidence). Where no independent score exists, the class (fastest, balanced, strongest) decides. Every repo and its Q4_0 file was checked on Hugging Face (October 2026); the Vectara figures were checked on the leaderboard's own page; speeds marked est. are estimates and are replaced by what your PC measures.

S.name: Qwen3-1.7B (native NPU bundle)
S.note: Runs fully on the NPU; instant replies. Speed measured by the app.

S.name: Qwen3-4B
S.note: Lowest summary hallucination (5.7%) among models of its size on the Vectara leaderboard; thinking can be switched off. Repo and Q4_0 file checked on Hugging Face.

S.name: Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507
S.note: Runs fully on the NPU; the app's own snake test passed. Speed measured by the app.

M.name: Qwen3-1.7B (native NPU bundle)
M.note: Runs fully on the NPU; instant replies. Speed measured by the app.

M.name: Qwen3-8B
M.note: Lowest summary hallucination (4.8%) of the models of 9B and under on the Vectara leaderboard; use it without thinking for summaries. Repo and Q4_0 file checked on Hugging Face.

M.name: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct
M.note: Best of its size on BigCodeBench-Hard (20.3%) among instruct models; older than the Qwen3 family but the only code model of this size with an independent score. Repo and Q4_0 file checked on Hugging Face.

M.name: Qwen3.5-9B
M.note: Strongest generalist under 10B on the independent index at launch, but its rank flips between index versions and it summarises less faithfully than Qwen3. Repo and Q4_0 file checked on Hugging Face.
